description: Search the mixin tables Blizzard's UI uses — reusable method sets attached to frames via the XML mixin attribute or CreateFromMixins. Searching a method name finds the mixin that defines it. Use this to reuse Blizzard's behaviour or to understand what a template's methods do.

query.description: Mixin name, fragment, or an exact method name.

name: wow_ui_mixin_search
title: Search Blizzard's Lua mixins
